title: Thinking on the Careers & Identity of Fran Dunaway and Aditi Dimri
summary: Kahran and Divya debrief on their two recent interviews — Fran Dunaway (TomboyX cofounder) and Aditi Dimri (economist turned health startup founder) — and the shared thread that neither treated career changes as identity crises. They explore identity as exoskeleton (something to hold you in) vs endoskeleton (an inner sense that lets you flow), Julia Cameron's The Artist's Way, and why creative people seem more identity-anxious than scientists or researchers.

intents.display: to think about changing careers without it becoming an identity crisis
